/* ==========================================================================
   The Set Edit | design system v2 "Gallery Edit" (homepage approval build)
   Source of truth: The Set Edit Website Developer Master Brief, section 2.
   Palette: Gallery White, Onyx, Travertine, Oxide, Brushed Aluminium, Parchment.
   Type: Inter Display (Inter 4 at opsz 32) for the wordmark, headlines and
   navigation, Inter at text size for body copy, PT Mono for labels.
   Square corners, hairline rules and restrained colour: Oxide is the only accent.
   ========================================================================== */
:root{
  /* Brand palette (exact values from the brief) */
  --gallery-white:#F4F1EB;
  --onyx:#151515;
  --travertine:#CFC1B2;
  --oxide:#A6513D;
  --aluminium:#A8A8A5;
  --parchment:#E7E0D7;
  /* Derived tokens: accessibility and interaction states only */
  --card:#FBF9F5;            /* Gallery White lift for cards, panels and the form */
  --oxide-deep:#86402F;      /* Oxide text on Parchment; Oxide button hover */
  --oxide-ink:#74372A;       /* Oxide text on Travertine */
  --oxide-lift:#D7917C;      /* Oxide text on Onyx */
  --aluminium-deep:#7E7E7A;  /* control borders and diagram strokes, 3:1 on light */
  /* Text */
  --ink:#151515;
  --body:#2E2B27;
  --muted:#56504A;
  /* Rules */
  --line:#CFC1B2;
  --rule:rgba(21,21,21,.16);
  --rule-strong:rgba(21,21,21,.28);
  /* Dark surface tokens */
  --dark-heading:#F4F1EB;
  --dark-body:#E7E0D7;
  --dark-muted:#A8A8A5;
  --dark-line:rgba(244,241,235,.16);
  --dark-line-strong:rgba(244,241,235,.32);
  /* Type */
  --font-display:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-mono:"PT Mono",ui-monospace,"SFMono-Regular",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --opsz-display:"opsz" 32;
  --fs-h1:clamp(3rem,1.6rem + 4.4vw,5.75rem);
  --fs-h2:clamp(1.75rem,1.2rem + 1.8vw,2.875rem);
  --fs-h3:.9375rem;
  --fs-lead:clamp(1.0625rem,1rem + .25vw,1.1875rem);
  --fs-body:1rem;
  --fs-small:.9375rem;
  --fs-xs:.8125rem;
  --fs-mono:.75rem;
  --track-display:.03em;
  --track-caps:.1em;
  --track-mono:.16em;
  /* Space */
  --s1:4px;--s2:8px;--s3:12px;--s4:16px;--s5:24px;--s6:32px;--s7:48px;--s8:64px;--s9:96px;
  --section-y:clamp(64px,3.5rem + 4vw,128px);
  --container:1320px;
  --gutter:clamp(16px,4vw,56px);
  --radius:0;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  --header-h:72px;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(var(--header-h) + 16px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--body);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.65;font-weight:400;font-optical-sizing:auto;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
ul,ol{margin:0;padding:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0;color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink));font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-weight:400}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.container{width:100%;max-width:var(--container);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
.visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;z-index:300;background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white);padding:12px 18px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none}
.skip-link:focus{top:12px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--c-focus,var(--oxide));outline-offset:3px}

/* ---------- Section themes (components read these variables) ---------- */
.band{position:relative;padding-block:var(--section-y);--c-heading:var(--ink);--c-text:var(--body);--c-muted:var(--muted);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide);--c-rule:var(--rule);--c-focus:var(--oxide);color:var(--c-text)}
.band--gallery{background:var(--gallery-white)}
.band--parchment{background:var(--parchment);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-deep);--c-focus:var(--oxide-deep)}
.band--travertine{background:var(--travertine);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-ink);--c-rule:var(--rule-strong);--c-focus:var(--onyx)}
.band--onyx,.theme-dark{--c-heading:var(--dark-heading);--c-text:var(--dark-body);--c-muted:var(--dark-muted);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-lift);--c-rule:var(--dark-line);--c-focus:var(--oxide-lift);color:var(--dark-body)}
.band--onyx{background:var(--onyx)}
.theme-dark{background:var(--onyx)}

/* ---------- Typography ---------- */
.eyebrow{display:block;margin:0 0 18px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-eyebrow,var(--oxide))}
.h2{font-size:var(--fs-h2);font-weight:300;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:var(--track-display);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-heading);text-wrap:balance}
.h2--sentence{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:-.012em;font-weight:300}
.card-title{font-size:var(--fs-h3);font-weight:500;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink))}
.lead{font-size:var(--fs-lead);line-height:1.62;color:var(--c-text);max-width:58ch}
.section-head{display:grid;gap:20px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(32px,4vw,56px)}
.section-head .lead{margin:0}
@media (min-width:960px){.section-head--split{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:var(--s8)}}
.section-foot{margin-top:clamp(28px,3vw,44px)}
.section-foot--split{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px 32px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--c-rule)}
.section-foot--split p{margin:0;color:var(--c-muted);font-size:var(--fs-small)}
.edit-grid + .section-foot--split,.au-grid + .section-foot--split{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
@media (min-width:1080px){.au-grid + .section-foot--split{border-top:1px solid var(--c-rule);padding-top:24px}}

/* ---------- Buttons and links ---------- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;padding:14px 24px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:400;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:background-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease)}
.btn i{font-size:.9em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.btn:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn--primary{background:var(--oxide);border-color:var(--oxide);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.btn--primary:hover{background:var(--oxide-deep);border-color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.btn--ink{background:var(--onyx);border-color:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.btn--ink:hover{background:var(--oxide-deep);border-color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.btn--light{background:var(--gallery-white);border-color:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--onyx)}
.btn--light:hover{background:var(--oxide-lift);border-color:var(--oxide-lift)}
.btn--outline{background:transparent;border-color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink));color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink))}
.btn--outline:hover{background:var(--onyx);border-color:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.btn--sm{min-height:44px;padding:11px 18px;font-size:.75rem}
.link-mono{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);line-height:1.4;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-eyebrow,var(--oxide));text-decoration:none}
.link-mono .link-text{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:5px;text-decoration-color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 35%,transparent)}
.link-mono i{font-size:.95em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.link-mono:hover .link-text{text-decoration-color:currentColor}
.link-mono:hover i{transform:translateX(4px)}
.link-mono:hover i.fa-arrow-down{transform:translateY(3px)}

/* ---------- Header and navigation ---------- */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(244,241,235,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:box-shadow .25s var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(21,21,21,.06)}
.header-inner{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s4);min-height:var(--header-h)}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:44px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;margin-right:auto}
.wordmark{font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1.375rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;color:inherit}
.site-nav{display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-list{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0}
.nav-link,.nav-trigger{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;background:none;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.nav-link::after,.nav-trigger::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:6px;height:1px;background:var(--oxide);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
.nav-trigger i{font-size:.625rem;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] i{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.nav-link:hover,.nav-trigger:hover,.nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"]{color:var(--oxide)}
.nav-link:hover::after,.nav-trigger:hover::after,.nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.header-cta{flex:0 0 auto;margin-left:10px}
.nav-cta-mobile{display:none}
.nav-toggle{display:none}
.nav-panel{display:none}
.panel-title{display:block;margin:0 0 12px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide)}
.panel-links{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:0}
.panel-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 0;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-size:.9375rem}
.panel-links a:hover{color:var(--oxide);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.panel-all{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:40px;margin-bottom:16px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.panel-all i{font-size:.85em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.panel-all:hover{color:var(--oxide)}
.panel-all:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.panel-note{padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.panel-note .panel-note-title{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark-heading)}
.panel-note p{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--dark-body)}
.panel-state-name{margin:0 0 6px}
.panel-state a.state-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.panel-state a.state-link:hover{color:var(--oxide)}

@media (min-width:1121px){
  .nav-item.has-panel{position:static}
  .nav-panel{position:absolute;left:var(--gutter);right:var(--gutter);top:100%;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:2px solid var(--onyx);box-shadow:0 28px 56px rgba(21,21,21,.10);padding:28px 32px 32px}
  .nav-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-24px;height:24px}
  .nav-item.is-open .nav-panel{display:block;animation:panelIn .18s var(--ease)}
  .panel-grid{display:grid;gap:36px}
  .panel-grid--hire{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.7fr 1.1fr}
  .panel-grid--hire .panel-links--two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:32px}
  #panel-styling{left:auto;width:min(760px,calc(100% - 2 * var(--gutter)))}
  .panel-grid--styling{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr}
  .panel-grid--locations{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .panel-grid--locations .panel-state + .panel-state{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:28px}
}
@media (min-width:1121px) and (max-width:1279px){
  .wordmark{font-size:1.1875rem;letter-spacing:.16em}
  .nav-link,.nav-trigger{padding-inline:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}
  .nav-link::after,.nav-trigger::after{left:9px;right:9px}
  .header-cta{margin-left:4px}
}
@keyframes panelIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

@media (max-width:1120px){
  .header-cta{order:2}
  .nav-toggle{order:3;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:46px;height:46px;border:1px solid var(--onyx);border-radius:var(--radius);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
  .nav-toggle i{font-size:1.05rem}
  .site-nav{position:fixed;inset:var(--header-h) 0 0 auto;width:min(440px,100%);background:var(--gallery-white);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-24px 0 48px rgba(21,21,21,.12);display:block;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px var(--gutter) 40px;transform:translateX(100%);visibility:hidden;transition:transform .28s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .28s}
  .site-nav.is-open{transform:none;visibility:visible;transition:transform .28s var(--ease),visibility 0s}
  .nav-list{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0}
  .nav-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .nav-link,.nav-trigger{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;min-height:58px;padding:16px 2px;font-size:.8125rem}
  .nav-link::after,.nav-trigger::after{display:none}
  .nav-item.is-open .nav-panel{display:block;padding:0 2px 20px}
  .panel-grid{display:grid;gap:20px}
  .panel-note{display:none}
  .nav-cta-mobile{display:flex;width:100%;margin-top:24px}
  .panel-grid--locations{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
.site-header .nav-toggle{flex:0 0 auto}
@media (max-width:520px){
  .header-inner{gap:8px}
  .wordmark{font-size:.9375rem;letter-spacing:.14em}
  .site-header .header-cta{margin-left:0;padding-inline:12px;font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .site-header .nav-toggle{width:44px;height:44px}
  .panel-grid--locations{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:359px){
  .site-header .header-cta{display:none}
}
.nav-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(21,21,21,.42);z-index:90;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .25s}
.nav-scrim.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .25s var(--ease)}
body.nav-locked{overflow:hidden}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{background:var(--parchment);container-type:inline-size;--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-deep);--c-focus:var(--oxide-deep)}
.hero-grid{display:grid}
.hero-panel{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:40px var(--gutter) 52px}
.hero-copy{width:100%;max-width:600px}
.hero-title{margin:0 0 26px;color:var(--ink)}
.hero-title-main{display:block;font-size:var(--fs-h1);font-weight:300;line-height:.96;letter-spacing:.025em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero-title-sub{display:block;margin-top:22px;font-size:clamp(1.25rem,1.05rem + .7vw,1.625rem);font-weight:400;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.008em;max-width:24ch;text-wrap:balance}
.hero-lead{font-size:var(--fs-lead);line-height:1.62;color:var(--body);max-width:48ch;margin:0 0 32px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:14px 28px}

/* ---------- Save to My Inspiration Gallery (occasion images) ---------- */
.occ-media{position:relative}
.save-btn{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.2);border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(244,241,235,.94);color:var(--onyx);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease)}
.save-btn i{font-size:.8125rem}
.save-btn:hover{background:var(--gallery-white);border-color:var(--onyx)}
.save-btn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--onyx);border-color:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.save-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--oxide);outline-offset:2px}
@media (pointer:coarse){.save-btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 14px}}

/* ---------- Build Your Brief: persistent trigger ---------- */
/* Shared look: Onyx panel, Gallery White label, Oxide detail. */
.brief-tab{position:fixed;z-index:80;margin:0;border:1px solid rgba(244,241,235,.28);background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white);font-family:var(--font-mono);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .2s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear 0s}
.brief-tab-rule{display:block;background:var(--oxide)}
.brief-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--oxide);outline-offset:3px}
body.brief-open .brief-tab,body.nav-locked .brief-tab{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .15s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .15s}

/* Large desktop (1101px and up): vertical tab on the right edge */
@media (min-width:1101px){
  .brief-tab{right:0;top:50%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:46px;padding:18px 0 20px;border-right:0;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.18em;transform:translateY(-50%);box-shadow:-12px 14px 34px rgba(21,21,21,.16);transition:width .22s var(--ease),opacity .2s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear 0s}
  .brief-tab-icon{font-size:.75rem}
  .brief-tab-rule{width:14px;height:2px;transition:width .22s var(--ease)}
  .brief-tab-label{writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);white-space:nowrap}
  .brief-tab:hover{width:52px}
  .brief-tab:hover .brief-tab-rule{width:24px}
}

/* Tablet and mobile (1100px and down): compact floating button, bottom right */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .brief-tab{right:16px;bottom:16px;display:inline-flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:48px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.14em;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(21,21,21,.3)}
  @supports (padding:max(0px)){
    .brief-tab{right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right));bottom:max(16px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px))}
  }
  .brief-tab-icon{font-size:.8125rem}
  .brief-tab-rule{width:12px;height:2px}
  .brief-tab-label{writing-mode:horizontal-tb;transform:none;white-space:nowrap}
  /* keep the floating button clear of the footer links at the end of the page */
  .site-footer{padding-bottom:96px}
  @supports (padding:max(0px)){
    .site-footer{padding-bottom:max(96px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 92px))}
  }
}
/* At the top of the page the sticky header already carries the same Build Your Brief button (360px and up),
   so the floating one stays out of the first screen and appears as soon as the page is scrolled. With
   JavaScript off the at-top class is never set, so the floating button is simply always visible. */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  body.at-top .brief-tab{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .18s}
}
/* Very small screens: the header button is hidden there, so the floating button stays, as a compact icon */
@media (max-width:359px){
  .brief-tab{right:12px;gap:0;width:48px;padding:0;border-radius:999px;justify-content:center}
  .brief-tab-rule,.brief-tab-label{display:none}
  .brief-tab-icon{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ---------- Build Your Brief: drawer ---------- */
body.brief-open{overflow:hidden}
.brief-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:rgba(21,21,21,.52);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .3s}
.brief-scrim.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.brief-drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:210;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:clamp(520px,40vw,600px);max-width:100%;height:100%;background:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--body);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-32px 0 64px rgba(21,21,21,.2);transform:translateX(100%);visibility:hidden;transition:transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),visibility 0s linear .38s;--c-heading:var(--ink);--c-text:var(--body);--c-muted:var(--muted);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide);--c-focus:var(--oxide)}
.brief-drawer.is-open{transform:none;visibility:visible;transition:transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),visibility 0s}
.brief-drawer [hidden]{display:none!important}
@media (max-width:1120px){.brief-drawer{width:min(720px,82vw)}}
@media (max-width:760px){.brief-drawer{width:100%;border-left:0}}
.bd-top{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2}
.bd-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:64px;padding:10px 12px 10px clamp(20px,4vw,36px);background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.bd-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gallery-white)}
.bd-label-rule{flex:0 0 auto;width:18px;height:2px;background:var(--oxide)}
.bd-close{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid rgba(244,241,235,.36);border-radius:var(--radius);background:transparent;color:var(--gallery-white);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease)}
.bd-close i{font-size:.9375rem}
.bd-close:hover{background:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--onyx)}
.bd-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--oxide-lift);outline-offset:2px}
.bd-progress{padding:14px clamp(20px,4vw,36px) 16px;background:var(--gallery-white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bd-progress-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px 16px;margin:0 0 10px}
.bd-count{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide)}
.bd-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bd-segs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.bd-seg{height:4px;background:var(--travertine);transition:background-color .25s var(--ease)}
.bd-seg.is-done{background:var(--onyx)}
.bd-seg.is-current{background:var(--oxide)}
.brief-drawer.is-after .bd-seg{background:var(--onyx)}
.bd-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;margin:0}
.bd-body{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:28px clamp(20px,4vw,36px) 40px;scroll-padding-block:20px;container-type:inline-size}
.bd-intro{margin-bottom:28px;padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bd-title{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:clamp(1.625rem,1.25rem + 1.1vw,2.125rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
.bd-intro p{margin:0;font-size:.9375rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--body);max-width:54ch}
.bd-intro .bd-required{margin-top:14px;font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted)}
.brief-drawer:not([data-current-step="1"]) .bd-intro{margin-bottom:24px;padding-bottom:16px}
.brief-drawer:not([data-current-step="1"]) .bd-title{margin-bottom:0;font-size:1.0625rem;letter-spacing:.08em}
.brief-drawer:not([data-current-step="1"]) .bd-intro-copy{display:none}
.brief-drawer:not([data-current-step="1"]) .bd-intro .bd-required{margin-top:6px}
.brief-drawer .req{color:var(--oxide)}
.bd-step-title{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.375rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bd-step-title:focus,.bd-after-title:focus,.bf-agreement:focus{outline:none}
.bd-prompt{margin:0 0 22px;font-size:1rem;color:var(--muted)}
.bd-fields{display:grid;gap:22px}
.bf-row{display:grid;gap:22px}
@container (min-width:460px){.bf-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:start}}
.brief-drawer .form-field input,.brief-drawer .form-field select,.brief-drawer .form-field textarea{background-color:var(--card)}
.brief-drawer .form-field input:focus,.brief-drawer .form-field select:focus,.brief-drawer .form-field textarea:focus{background-color:#fff}
.brief-drawer .form-field textarea{min-height:120px}
.bf-hint{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-xs);line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-soft{color:var(--oxide)}
.bf-error{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin:0;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.45;color:#A3261E}
.bf-error i{margin-top:3px;font-size:.8125rem}
.bf-field.has-error > input,.bf-field.has-error > select,.bf-field.has-error > textarea,.bf-field.has-error .bf-combo-box input{border-color:#A3261E;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #A3261E}
.bf-group.has-error .bf-options{outline:1px solid #A3261E;outline-offset:6px}
.bf-fieldset{min-width:0;margin:0;padding:0;border:0}
.bf-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:4px 12px;margin:0 0 12px;padding:0;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-legend-note{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.bf-category{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-category i{font-size:.6875rem;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-category-k{color:var(--muted)}
/* custom but native inputs: the input itself is the indicator, so focus and state stay with the control */
.brief-drawer input[type="checkbox"],.brief-drawer input[type="radio"]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;place-content:center;width:20px;height:20px;margin:0;border:1px solid var(--onyx);border-radius:0;background:var(--card);cursor:pointer}
.brief-drawer input[type="radio"]{border-radius:50%}
.brief-drawer input[type="checkbox"]::before{content:"";width:10px;height:5px;border-left:2px solid var(--gallery-white);border-bottom:2px solid var(--gallery-white);transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg);opacity:0}
.brief-drawer input[type="radio"]::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gallery-white);opacity:0}
.brief-drawer input[type="checkbox"]:checked,.brief-drawer input[type="radio"]:checked{background:var(--onyx)}
.brief-drawer input[type="checkbox"]:checked::before,.brief-drawer input[type="radio"]:checked::before{opacity:1}
.brief-drawer input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible,.brief-drawer input[type="radio"]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--oxide);outline-offset:3px}
.bf-cards{display:grid;gap:10px}
@container (min-width:460px){.bf-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.bf-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 14px;align-content:start;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--aluminium-deep);background:var(--card);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s var(--ease),background-color .15s var(--ease),box-shadow .15s var(--ease)}
.bf-card input{grid-row:1 / span 2;margin-top:1px}
.bf-card-t{font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-card-d{grid-column:2;font-size:var(--fs-xs);line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-card:hover,.bf-option:hover{border-color:var(--onyx)}
.bf-card.is-selected,.bf-option.is-selected{border-color:var(--onyx);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--onyx);background:var(--parchment)}
.bf-card.is-selected .bf-card-t,.bf-option.is-selected .bf-option-t{font-weight:600}
.bf-reveal{padding:16px;border-left:2px solid var(--oxide);background:var(--card);animation:bfReveal .2s var(--ease)}
@keyframes bfReveal{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.bf-options{display:grid;gap:8px}
@container (min-width:460px){.bf-options--2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.bf-options--3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.bf-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:52px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--aluminium-deep);background:var(--card);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s var(--ease),background-color .15s var(--ease),box-shadow .15s var(--ease)}
.bf-option-t{font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-combo-box{position:relative}
.bf-listbox{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(100% + 4px);z-index:5;max-height:264px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;margin:0;padding:4px 0;list-style:none;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--onyx);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(21,21,21,.16)}
.bf-listbox li{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:44px;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font-size:.9375rem}
.bf-listbox li + li{border-top:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.08)}
.bf-listbox li:hover,.bf-listbox li.is-active{background:var(--parchment)}
.bf-listbox li.is-active{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--oxide)}
.bf-opt-meta{flex:0 0 auto;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-combo-msg{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--oxide)}
.bf-combo-msg:empty{display:none}
.bf-captured{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-captured i{color:var(--oxide)}
.bf-captured-k{color:var(--muted)}
.bf-date{padding:0;transition:padding .2s var(--ease),background-color .2s var(--ease)}
.bf-date.is-emphasised{padding:16px;border-left:2px solid var(--oxide);background:var(--card)}
.bf-date.is-emphasised > label{font-size:1rem}
.bf-date input{max-width:280px}
.bf-date-flag{margin-left:8px;padding:3px 7px;background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.625rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;vertical-align:2px}
.bf-lead{margin:-8px 0 0;font-size:.9375rem;color:var(--body)}
.bf-block{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.bf-block-k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-block-no{color:var(--oxide)}
.bf-drop{position:relative;border:1px dashed var(--aluminium-deep);background:var(--card);transition:border-color .15s var(--ease),background-color .15s var(--ease)}
.bf-drop:hover,.bf-drop.is-over{border-color:var(--onyx);border-style:solid;background:#fff}
.bf-drop:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--oxide);outline-offset:3px}
.bf-file{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}
.bf-drop-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:26px 16px;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.bf-drop-label i{font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--oxide)}
.bf-drop-t{font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-drop-u{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.bf-drop-d{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted)}
.bf-count{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-count:empty{display:none}
.bf-thumbs{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(136px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:0;padding:0}
.bf-thumb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 44px;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card)}
.bf-thumb img{grid-column:1 / -1;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}
.bf-thumb-name{align-self:center;padding:0 8px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.625rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-remove{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--onyx);cursor:pointer}
.bf-remove:hover{background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.bf-remove:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--oxide);outline-offset:2px}
.bf-empty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0;padding:18px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-size:.9375rem;color:var(--muted)}
.bf-empty i{color:var(--aluminium-deep)}
.bf-gallery-saved{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
.bf-gallery-set{width:100%}
.bf-gallery-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:0;padding:0}
.bf-gtile{position:relative;display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);cursor:pointer}
.bf-gtile img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}
.bf-gtile input{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;background:rgba(251,249,245,.94)}
.bf-gtile-t{display:block;padding:7px 9px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-gtile.is-selected{border-color:var(--onyx);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--onyx)}
.bf-selected{width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border-left:2px solid var(--oxide);background:var(--card)}
.bf-selected-k{margin:0 0 10px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-selected-list{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:0}
.bf-selected-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.bf-selected-list img{width:48px;height:36px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.bf-selected-list span{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;font-size:.875rem;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-selected-list .bf-remove{width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--onyx)}
.bf-selected-list .bf-remove:hover{background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.brief-drawer .form-disclosure{margin:26px 0 0;font-size:.8125rem}
.bf-agreement{margin:14px 0 0;padding:18px 20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:2px solid var(--onyx)}
.bf-agreement.is-flagged{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--oxide)}
.bf-agreement-flag{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0 0 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--oxide)}
.bf-agreement-flag i{margin-top:3px}
.bf-agreement-t{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.bf-agreement ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:0}
.bf-agreement li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;font-size:.9375rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--body)}
.bf-agreement li::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:8px;background:var(--oxide)}
.bd-nav{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px clamp(20px,4vw,36px) calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--gallery-white);border-top:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 -14px 28px rgba(21,21,21,.05)}
.bd-nav .btn{min-height:50px}
.bd-nav .bd-back i{transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.bd-nav .bd-back:hover i{transform:translateX(-3px)}
.bd-next,.bd-send{margin-left:auto}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .bd-nav{gap:10px}
  .bd-nav .btn{padding-inline:14px;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .bd-next,.bd-send{flex:1 1 auto}
}
.bd-after{padding-top:34px}
.bd-kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 12px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide)}
.bd-after-title{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,1.2rem + 1vw,2rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.bd-after-copy{margin:0 0 24px;font-size:1rem;color:var(--body);max-width:48ch}

.dest-col li a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-rule);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.dest-col li a .dn{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500}
.dest-col li a .dd{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--c-muted)}
.dest-col li a:hover .dn{color:var(--oxide-deep);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.localities--near li span{white-space:nowrap}
@media (min-width:1100px){.localities--near{columns:3}}
.svc .svc-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:24px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.svc .svc-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0}
.svc .svc-link:focus-visible{outline:none}
.svc--lead:hover h3{color:var(--oxide-deep)}
